verdict.rationale: Agora is a real-time video platform, so simulcast or layered publishing with per-subscriber layer adaptation is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions simulcast, dual-stream, SVC layers, or bandwidth-based layer selection for subscribers. Quality monitoring and analytics are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth
